cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Affectionate Resentment
cards.instruction: Remain warm and familiar while letting old resentment sharpen beneath every caring gesture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I've warmed your side of the bed, love. You sounded frozen waiting for that taxi.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You could have picked me up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I could. Here's another blanket. I remember waiting outside your office last Christmas.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I apologised. Could you warm my feet?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come here, love. Both feet. I wouldn't leave any part of you waiting forty minutes.
